Helper libraries used by this project

Project source follows the dlssg-to-fsr3 repository's GPLv3 license
(LICENSE.md). The NVIDIA runtime DLL and extracted/recompiled NVIDIA kernel
assets are separate third-party material from this user's local installation;
they are not relicensed by LICENSE.md. The bundled runtime is an unmodified
nvngx_dlssg.dll 310.1.0.0 with SHA256:
c989c0ebd9cd21dbf3db0becd857aa1f218068d94da371d924331a6f0fb97525

SM75 GPU assets: thank you to Coldwood1026 for the RTX 20-series / SM75 work.
Repository: https://github.com/Coldwood1026/dlssg_for_sm75 (previous name:
Coldwood1026/dlssg_for_sm86).
Pinned source:
https://github.com/Coldwood1026/dlssg_for_sm75/commit/c60c2aa363c7e66a523122aa5cec9c884658ad5f
No CPU host from that binary is embedded. PTX container lengths, termination and
alignment were repaired, and the PTX ISA declaration of the 33 image kernels was
normalised from 8.7 to 8.5 (payload text and container field; no instruction
text changed). Two families ship: assets/kernels/sm75 carries PTX with one
further recorded rewrite (the f16x2 .local unpack repair) and cubins this project
built from it with ptxas, while assets/kernels/sm75/original carries that
repository's 72 sm_75 cubins byte for byte and its PTX with only the .version
normalisation, selected by [Compatibility] SM75Family=Original so a Turing owner
can A/B the repair. Those assets are themselves derivatives of NVIDIA kernel code
and are third-party material in the same bucket as assets/runtime/nvngx_dlssg.dll:
they are not relicensed by LICENSE.md. The per-file manifests with every source
and imported SHA256 are assets/kernels/sm75/index.json and
assets/kernels/sm75/original/index.json.
